adaptations.why: The coin door panel itself keeps its drawn layout, but the body around it stretched: the single pair of buttons/lights now appears as four, and smeared repeated bands and blank streaks appear across the flank and below.
adaptations.did: Across the prop it is `spanx_center`. Because a plain flank was measured on it, and the extra width is inserted there. Down the prop it is `spany_repeat`. Because the prop was said to get taller BY this part -- a leg, column or upright that simply gets longer.

adaptations.why: The taller body's side artwork shows vertically smeared, streaky robot/rocket fragments and repeated seam bands that image 1 does not have.
adaptations.did: The carcass grows by INSERTING COPIES of its own artwork at rows 1..251 (at the itself of backglass), rows 333..619 (at the itself of coin_door_panel) -- 536 rows of a 621-row elevation, chosen because nothing is drawn across them. Everything above and below a place holds its drawn size and simply moves apart.
